Title: ~Homebrew~ ~Demo~ New Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog, The
RichPresencePatch:
Lookup:action
0,2=🦘
1,3=🧍
5,7=🏃

Lookup:symbol
4=⏿
5,12,14-15=🏁
13,16=

Lookup:text
4=is viewing the credits.
5,12,14-15=has cleared a Zone!
6=Peridot Coast, Act 1
7=Peridot Coast, Act 2
8=Marble Valley, Act 1
9=Marble Valley, Act 2
10=Robotropolis, Act 1
11=Robotropolis, Act 2
13=is on the splash screen.
16=is on the title screen.

Display:
